hero.lead: Join an open room or create your own. You can set up the rest in the lobby with the other players.

rooms.title: Open rooms
rooms.emptyText: Create the first one — it will show up here right away.

create.title: Create a room
create.name: Room name
create.passwordHint: You need it to set up the seats and start the game.
create.rolePriceHint: How much influence a free role costs.
create.submit: Create and go to the lobby →
create.hintMissing: Enter a name and a password (4+ characters).

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.text: The room and the whole game will be gone for good.

lobby.titleWaiting: Pick a seat and fill the table
lobby.leadWaiting: People and bots can play together. To start, you need at least two players, and at least one of them must be a person.
lobby.leadRunning: The game is already running. Enter the password and pick your seat.
lobby.accessNote: Pick a free seat. If you are coming back to a game, click your old seat.
lobby.checkHuman: At least one person at the table
lobby.meetChecks: Tick all the boxes above and the button will turn on.

seat.emptyHint: Take it yourself or add a bot

about.title: A board game I am making myself
about.p1: Hi! City of Influence is my own board game. I make it in my free time, just because I love it. My dream is to see it one day as a real box on the table.
about.p2: and it will stay free: no ads and no paid advantages. Everyone plays on equal terms.
about.p3Start: If you like the game and want to help, you can support the project with any amount. All the money will go to
about.p3Strong: printing the first batch of the board game
about.p3End: : the cards, the board and the box.
about.p4: Your opinion means a lot to me. Found a bug, something is unclear, or you have an idea? Please write to me on the feedback page — I read every message.

feedback.title: Tell me what you think
feedback.lead: Here you can report a bug, share an idea or just tell me how you like the game. I read every message. Leave a contact and I will try to reply.
feedback.support: Like the project? You can support it — the money goes to printing the board game.

bug.title: I found a bug
bug.hint: Something is broken or works wrong
bug.placeholder: What happened, and what did you do just before? If you remember the round, the role or the card — even better.

idea.title: I have an idea
idea.placeholder: What would you add to the game or do differently?

other.title: Just saying hi
other.placeholder: Write it just as it is — I really want to know.

feedback.contact: How can I reach you — if you want a reply
feedback.note: We also send the game version and your browser type — it helps to find bugs.
feedback.errorTooMany: Too many messages in a row. Please wait a minute and try again.
feedback.errorFailed: Could not send. Check your internet and try again — your text is still here.
feedback.doneText: It really helps to make the game better.
